module_summary: SERV buffer register: a bit-serial adder sums gated rs1 and immediate into a 32-bit shift register that provides the data-bus address, shifts and serial output.

anchors.name: data
anchors.why: 32-bit shift register holding computed address/rs1; feeds o_q, o_dbus_adr, o_ext_rs1.

anchors.name: q
anchors.why: Serial adder sum of gated rs1, gated imm and carry, shifted into data.

anchors.name: c_r
anchors.why: Carry flip-flop of the serial adder held between bit cycles.

anchors.name: i_en
anchors.why: Shift enable for data register, carry update and o_q output gating.

anchors.name: i_init
anchors.why: Selects loading adder sum vs sign-fill shift into data register.

anchors.name: i_rs1_en
anchors.why: Gates rs1 operand into the serial adder.

anchors.name: i_imm_en
anchors.why: Gates immediate operand into the serial adder.

anchors.name: clr_lsb
anchors.why: Clears immediate LSB at cnt0 for jalr target alignment.

anchors.name: i_sh_signed
anchors.why: Selects arithmetic sign fill when shifting data register.

anchors.name: i_rs1
anchors.why: Serial rs1 operand input to the adder.

anchors.name: i_imm
anchors.why: Serial immediate operand input to the adder.

anchors.name: o_q
anchors.why: Serial output bit from data register gated by i_en.

anchors.name: o_dbus_adr
anchors.why: Word-aligned data bus address taken from data register.

anchors.name: o_lsb
anchors.why: Address low bits for byte-lane selection, zero for MDU ops.

anchors.name: o_ext_rs1
anchors.why: Full parallel data register exported to extension units.

groups.name: Serial adder
groups.description: Bit-serial add of gated rs1 and immediate with carry flip-flop.

groups.name: Buffer shift register
groups.description: 32-bit shift register loaded from adder or shifted with sign fill.

groups.name: Outputs
groups.description: Serial output, data bus address, address LSBs and extension rs1.
